title.zh: 卷三十 本紀第三十 高宗七
title.raw: 卷三十 本紀第三十 高宗七 Volume 30 Annals 30: Gaozong 7

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月癸卯，罷樞密行府。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, day guimao: the Privy Council field office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 12, spring, guimao: the mobile Privy Council office was shut down.

sentences.zh: 庚申，孫近分司、漳州居住。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Sun Jin was dismissed from office and ordered to reside in Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Sun Jin was stripped of his post and sent to live in Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，加建國公瑗為檢校少保，進封普安郡王。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: Establishing-State Duke Yuan was made acting Junior Guardian and advanced to Prince of Pu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingchou: Establishing-State Duke Yuan was made acting Junior Guardian and created Prince of Pu'an.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜楊沂中名存中。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Yang Yizhong was granted the name Cunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Yang Yizhong received the taboo name Cunzhong.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔諸州修學宮。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: an edict ordered all prefectures to repair Confucian academies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, every prefecture was ordered to repair its Confucian school.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蠲廣南東、西路駱科殘擾州縣今年租。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: this year's rent was remitted for prefectures and counties in Guangnan East and West routes ravaged by the Luo bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, rent was forgiven for Guangnan East and West counties still recovering from the Luo raids.

sentences.zh: 鎮江、太平、池州、蕪湖大火。

translations.literal: Great fires struck Zhenjiang, Taiping, Chizhou, and Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Fires swept Zhenjiang, Taiping, Chizhou, and Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，金主許歸梓宮及皇太后，遣何鑄等還。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the Jin ruler agreed to return the imperial coffin and the Empress Dowager; He Zhu and others were sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the Jin court agreed to return the imperial coffin and Empress Dowager; He Zhu's mission came home.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，臨安府火。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: Lin'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingshen: fire broke out in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命普安郡王出就第，朝朔望。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Prince of Pu'an was ordered to leave the palace for his mansion and attend court only on the first and fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Prince of Pu'an moved to his own residence and was to attend only on new and full moon.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以士亻褭嘗營護岳飛為朋比，責建州居住。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: because Shi Lou had once helped guard Yue Fei, he was charged with factional collusion and demoted to reside in Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Shi Lou—who had once helped guard Yue Fei—was punished as a partisan and sent to Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，胡世將卒。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Hu Shijiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Hu Shijiang died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子朔，遣孟忠厚為迎護梓宮禮儀使，王次翁為奉迎兩宮禮儀使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiazi new moon: Meng Zhonghou was made commissioner for receiving and escorting the imperial coffin; Wang Ciweng was made commissioner for welcoming the Two Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiazi new moon: Meng Zhonghou was named to receive the coffin; Wang Ciweng to welcome Empress Dowager and coffin.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，皇太后偕梓宮發五國城，金遣完顏宗賢、劉祹護送梓宮，高居安護送皇太后。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Empress Dowager set out with the coffin from the Five States City; the Jin sent Wanyan Zongxian and Liu Shan to escort the coffin, and Gao Ju'an to escort the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Dowager and coffin left the Five States City; Jin escorts were Wanyan Zongxian, Liu Shan, and Gao Ju'an for the Dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜禮部進士陳誠之以下二百五十四人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: two hundred fifty-four men including Presented Scholar Chen Chengzhi of the Ministry of Rites were granted jinshi degrees and passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Chen Chengzhi and 253 others received jinshi degrees and passes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封韋淵平樂郡王。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wei Yuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wei Yuan was created Prince of Pingle.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，皇后邢氏崩訃初至。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: first word arrived that Empress Xing had died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, news first arrived that Empress Xing was dead.

sentences.zh: 甲申，增修臨安府學為太學。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Lin'an prefecture's school was expanded and upgraded to the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Lin'an's prefectural school was enlarged into the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，以鄭剛中為川、陝宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: Zheng Gangzhong was made Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification and disposition vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiawu: Zheng Gangzhong became Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣沈昭遠等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Shen Zhaoyuan and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Shen Zhaoyuan and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 置淮西、京西、陝西諸路榷場。

translations.literal: Frontier markets were established on the Huai West, Jing West, and Shaanxi routes.
translations.idiomatic: Controlled border markets were set up on Huai West, Jing West, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，增築慈寧殿。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the Cining Hall was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Cining Hall was expanded.

sentences.zh: 停給度僧牒。

translations.literal: Issuance of ordination certificates for monks was halted.
translations.idiomatic: The state stopped issuing ordination certificates to monks.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，復試教官法。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the method of re-examining instructors was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the instructor re-examination system was restored.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，命侍從、台諫、禮官雜議權奉欑宮。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiazi: attendants-in-waiting, remonstrance officials, and rites officials were ordered to discuss jointly how to provisionally house the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiazi: courtiers, censors, and rites officers were told to debate interim housing for the returning coffin.

sentences.zh: 戌辰，以万俟禼為欑宮按行使。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Wan Qixie was made commissioner for inspecting the provisional tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wan Qixie was named to oversee the provisional tomb arrangements.

sentences.zh: 辛未，責降王庶為向德軍節度副使、道州安置。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Wang Shu was demoted to Xiangde Army vice commissioner and assigned to Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wang Shu was demoted to Xiangde Army vice commissioner and sent to Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，金國歸孟庾、李正民。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Jin returned Meng Geng and Li Zhengmin.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Jin sent back Meng Geng and Li Zhengmin.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以吳璘為檢校少師、階、成、岷、鳳四州經略使。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Wu Lin was made acting Junior Mentor and commissioner for Jie, Cheng, Min, and Feng prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wu Lin became acting Junior Mentor and commissioner over Jie, Cheng, Min, and Feng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰朔，福州簽判胡銓除名、新州編管。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renchen new moon: Fuzhou registrar Hu Quan was expelled from office and banished to supervise in Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renchen new moon: Hu Quan was cashiered and banished to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上皇后諡曰懿節，祔神主於別廟。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the late empress was given the posthumous title Yijie; her spirit tablet was enshrined in a side temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the empress was posthumously titled Yijie and her tablet placed in a side shrine.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以何鑄權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jihai: He Zhu was made acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, He Zhu was appointed acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，始制常行儀仗及造玉輅。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: regular ceremonial guards and a jade imperial carriage were first ordered made.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the court first ordered standing guard of honor and a jade imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，蠲廣南、湖北沿邊州軍免行錢。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the exemption-fee levy was remitted for frontier prefectures and armies in Guangnan and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, frontier exemption fees were cut in Guangnan and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉朔，兀朮使來求商州及和尚、方山二原。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinyou new moon: Wuzhu's envoy came seeking Shangzhou and the Heshang and Fangshan pasturelands.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinyou new moon: Wuzhu's envoy demanded Shangzhou and the Heshang and Fangshan ranges.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，何鑄罷。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: He Zhu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, He Zhu left office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以万俟禼參知政事，充金國報謝使。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Wan Qixie was made Vice Grand Councilor and Jin return-thanks envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Wan Qixie became Vice Grand Councilor and chief envoy to thank the Jin.

sentences.zh: 壬午，皇太后至，入居慈甯宮。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Empress Dowager arrived and took up residence in the Cining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Empress Dowager came home and entered the Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝易緦服，奉迎徽宗及顯肅、懿節二後梓宮至，奉安于龍德別宮。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Emperor changed to hemp mourning, welcomed the coffins of Huizong and Empresses Xiansu and Yijie, and installed them at the Longde side palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Gaozong donned hemp mourning, received Huizong's coffin and those of Empresses Xiansu and Yijie, and lodged them at Longde.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄭剛中分畫陝西地界，割商、秦之半畀金國，存上津、豐陽、天水三縣及隴西成紀餘地，棄和尚、方山二原，以大散關為界。

translations.literal: That month, Zheng Gangzhong divided the Shaanxi border, ceding half of Shang and Qin to the Jin, retaining Shangjin, Fengyang, Tianshui counties and the remainder of Longxi and Chengji, abandoning the Heshang and Fangshan ranges, with the Great Scatter Pass as boundary.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zheng Gangzhong drew the Shaanxi line: half of Shang and Qin went to the Jin; Shangjin, Fengyang, Tianshui, and scraps of Longxi and Chengji stayed; Heshang and Fangshan were given up; Great Scatter Pass marked the border.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，以孟忠厚為樞密使，充欑宮總護使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiwei: Meng Zhonghou was made Privy Council Director and overall commissioner for the provisional tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yiwei: Meng Zhonghou became Privy Council Director and chief overseer of the provisional tomb.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大赦。

translations.literal: Day renyin: a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the court proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，加秦檜太師，封魏國公。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Qin Hui was advanced to Grand Mentor and enfeoffed Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Qin Hui was made Grand Mentor and Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 丙午，金使劉筈、完顏宗表等九人入見。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: nine Jin envoys including Liu Kuo and Wanyan Zongbiao had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, nine Jin envoys led by Liu Kuo and Wanyan Zongbiao were received.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以王次翁等充金國報謝使。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Ciweng and others were made Jin return-thanks envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Wang Ciweng and others were sent to thank the Jin.

sentences.zh: 藏金國誓書於內侍省。

translations.literal: The Jin oath-document was stored in the Inner Service Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin peace oath was locked in the Inner Service Directorate.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，加張中孚開府儀同三司，中彥靖海軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhang Zhongfu was advanced to Palace Minister with credentials equal to the Three Dukes; Zhong Yan was made Jinghai Army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhang Zhongfu was raised to Palace Minister of the First Rank; Zhong Yan became Jinghai Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，杖殺偽福國長公主李善靜。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the false Princess of Fuguo, Li Shanjing, was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the impostor Princess of Fuguo, Li Shanjing, was flogged to death.

sentences.zh: 以金州郭浩為金、房、開、達四州經略安撫使。

translations.literal: Jinzhou's Guo Hao was made commissioner and pacification commissioner for Jin, Fang, Kai, and Da prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Hao of Jinzhou was made commissioner over Jin, Fang, Kai, and Da.

sentences.zh: 始遣楊願使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: Yang Yuan was first sent as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuan was first dispatched to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，始聽中外用藥。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yichou: medicine was first permitted for use inside and outside the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yichou: the court first allowed medicine to be used throughout the palace and bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，權欑徽宗皇帝及顯肅皇后于會稽永固陵，懿節皇后祔。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Huizong and Empress Xiansu were provisionally entombed at Kuaiji's Yonggu Tomb; Empress Yijie was appended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Huizong and Empress Xiansu were lodged at Kuaiji's Yonggu Tomb; Empress Yijie was joined there.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以翰林學士程克俊簽書樞密院事、權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Hanlin Academician Cheng Kejun was made acting Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Cheng Kejun was made acting Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以皇太后回鑾，推恩進封秦檜為秦、魏兩國公，辭不拜。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: because the Empress Dowager had returned, favor was extended and Qin Hui was advanced to Duke of both Qin and Wei; he declined.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, to mark the Dowager's return Qin Hui was offered the double dukedom of Qin and Wei; he refused.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以何鑄党援岳飛，不主和議，責授秘書少監、徽州居住。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: because He Zhu had backed Yue Fei and opposed the peace policy, he was demoted to Secretariat Vice Director and ordered to reside in Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, He Zhu—who had aided Yue Fei and resisted peace—was demoted to Secretariat Vice Director and sent to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇太后生辰，上壽于慈甯宮。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: on the Empress Dowager's birthday, the Emperor offered longevity congratulations in the Cining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Gaozong celebrated the Dowager's birthday in the Cining Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，置福建路提舉茶事司。

translations.literal: A Fujian-route tea-supervision office was established.
translations.idiomatic: The court set up a Fujian-route office to supervise the tea trade.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月戊戌，加上徽宗諡曰體神合道駿烈遜功聖文仁德憲慈顯孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, spring, first month, day wuxu: Huizong's posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Tishen Hedao Junlie Xungong Shengwen Rende Xianci Xianxiao.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 13, spring, wuxu: Huizong received his long posthumous title as Tishen Hedao Junlie Xungong Shengwen Rende Xianci Xianxiao.

sentences.zh: 己亥，親饗太廟，奉上冊寶。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the Emperor personally offered in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and presented the register and seals.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Gaozong personally sacrificed in the Ancestral Temple and presented the register and seals.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，增建國子監太學。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Directorate of Education and Imperial University were enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Directorate of Education and the Imperial University were expanded.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復兼試進士經義、試賦。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the combined examination of jinshi in classical meaning and fu poetry was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, jinshi examinations again combined classical meaning and fu poetry.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，初御前殿，特引四參官起居。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: the Emperor first held court in the front hall and specially summoned fourth-rank officials for the routine greeting.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renxu: Gaozong first held audience in the front hall and called fourth-rank officials to the routine greeting.

sentences.zh: 甲子，制郊廟社稷祭器。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: suburban, temple, and altar ritual vessels were ordered made.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, ritual vessels for the suburban altars, temples, and grain altars were commissioned.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，更永固陵曰永祐。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Yonggu Tomb was renamed Yongyou.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Yonggu Tomb was renamed Yongyou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，封韓世忠咸安郡王。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Han Shizhong was enfeoffed Prince of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Han Shizhong was created Prince of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蠲雷、化等十州免行錢。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the exemption-fee levy was remitted for ten prefectures including Lei and Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, exemption fees were cut in ten prefectures including Lei and Hua.

sentences.zh: 丙子，造金、象、革、木四輅。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: gold, ivory, leather, and wooden imperial carriages were made.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, gold, ivory, leather, and wooden imperial carriages were built.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，立太學及科舉試法。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: regulations for the Imperial University and civil-service examinations were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the court fixed rules for the Imperial University and the examination system.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，秘書少監秦熺修《建炎以來日曆》成。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Secretariat Vice Director Qin Xi finished compiling the Calendar from the Jianyan Reign Onward.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Qin Xi completed the Calendar from the Jianyan Reign Onward.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，建景靈宮，奉安累朝神禦。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the Jingling Palace was built to house spirit tablets of successive reigns.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the Jingling Palace was raised to receive spirit tablets of past emperors.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，造鹵簿儀仗。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: halberd guards and ceremonial regalia were made.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jihai: halberd guards and full ceremonial regalia were ordered.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，建社稷壇。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the altars of soil and grain were built.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the altars of soil and grain were erected.

sentences.zh: 丙午，築圜丘。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the Circular Mound Altar was constructed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Circular Mound Altar was built.

sentences.zh: 振淮南饑民。

translations.literal: Famine victims in Huainan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: The court relieved famine in Huainan.

sentences.zh: 仍禁遏糴。

translations.literal: Hoarding grain for profit was still forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Private hoarding of grain for profit remained banned.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，頒鄉飲酒儀于郡國。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: village drinking rites were issued to commanderies and states.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guihai: village drinking ceremonies were promulgated to the provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，毀獄吏訊囚非法之具。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: illegal instruments used by prison clerks to interrogate prisoners were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, illegal torture tools in the prisons were smashed.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，立貴妃吳氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jichou: Honored Consort Wu was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jichou: Honored Consort Wu was made empress.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命史館編《靖康建炎忠義錄》。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the History Office was ordered to compile the Record of Loyalists in the Jingkang and Jianyan Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the History Office was told to compile loyalists of the Jingkang and Jianyan years.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，楊政入見，加檢校少保，賜田五十頃。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Yang Zheng had audience; he was made acting Junior Guardian and granted fifty qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yang Zheng was received, made acting Junior Guardian, and given fifty qing of land.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蠲諸路無名月樁錢。

translations.literal: Day renzi: unnamed monthly pile levies on all routes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, unnamed monthly pile taxes on every route were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，王次翁罷。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Wang Ciweng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Wang Ciweng left office.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，張九成坐党趙鼎，南安軍居住。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: Zhang Jiucheng, convicted as Zhao Ding's partisan, was ordered to reside in Nan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiazi: Zhang Jiucheng, judged Zhao Ding's man, was sent to Nan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 壬申，置國子博士、正、錄。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Directorate Erudites, Rectors, and Recorders were established.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Directorate gained Erudites, Rectors, and Recorders.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，命諸路置放生池。

translations.literal: Day yihai: all routes were ordered to establish ponds for releasing captive animals.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, every route was ordered to set up life-release ponds.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，天申節，始上壽錫宴如故事。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: on the Tian Shen festival, longevity congratulations and banquets were first held as of old.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Tian Shen festival was again celebrated with birthday rites and banquets as before.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，禁三衙及諸軍市易，月增將官供給錢有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu: the Three Yamen guards and all armies were forbidden to trade in markets; monthly allowances for officer ranks were increased by grade.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renxu: the Three Yamen and all armies were barred from market trade; officer stipends were raised by rank.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，程克俊罷，以万俟禼兼權簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Cheng Kejun was dismissed; Wan Qixie was additionally made acting Privy Council Signatory.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Cheng Kejun left office; Wan Qixie also became acting Privy Council Signatory.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔諸路提刑歲舉部內廉明平恕獄官。

translations.literal: Day wushen: route judicial commissioners were ordered each year to recommend honest, fair prison officials within their circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, route judicial commissioners were told to recommend fair prison officers yearly.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，金遣洪皓、張邵、朱弁來歸。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Jin sent Hong Hao, Zhang Shao, and Zhu Bian home.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the Jin released Hong Hao, Zhang Shao, and Zhu Bian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，詔求遺書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiazi: an edict sought lost books.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiazi: the court sought lost books.

sentences.zh: 罷捕賊補官格。

translations.literal: The regulation promoting officials for capturing bandits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions for catching bandits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，處州兵士楊興等謀作亂，事覺伏誅。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Chuzhou soldiers Yang Xing and others plotted rebellion; discovered, they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Chuzhou troops led by Yang Xing plotted mutiny; exposed, they were put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，置諸州銅作務。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: copper workshops were established in the prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, prefectural copper workshops were set up.

sentences.zh: 壬申，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day renshen: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 蠲浙西貧民逋負丁鹽錢。

translations.literal: Arrears of salt-tax head money owed by the poor in western Zhejiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Poor households' overdue salt head-tax in western Zhejiang was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，遣吏部侍郎江邈奉迎累朝神禦於溫州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: Ministry of Personnel Vice Minister Jiang Miao was sent to welcome successive reigns' spirit tablets from Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingxu: Jiang Miao of the Ministry of Personnel was sent to bring spirit tablets from Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命諸路有出身監司一員提舉學事。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: each route was ordered to have one circuit intendant with examination background supervise schools.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, each route was to assign one examination-born intendant to oversee schools.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，洪皓至自金國，入見。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Hong Hao arrived from the Jin and had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Hong Hao returned from the Jin and was received.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣鄭朴等使金賀正旦，王師心等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Zheng Pu and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year; Wang Shixin and others to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zheng Pu congratulated the Jin New Year; Wang Shixin and others the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 鄭剛中獻黃金萬兩。

translations.literal: Zheng Gangzhong presented ten thousand taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Gangzhong offered ten thousand taels of gold.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復昌化、萬安、吉陽軍。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Changhua, Wan'an, and Jiyang armies were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Changhua, Wan'an, and Jiyang garrisons were restored.

sentences.zh: 知階州田晟將所部三千人赴行在。

translations.literal: Jie prefecture prefect Tian Sheng led three thousand of his troops to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Sheng, prefect of Jie, marched three thousand men to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以晟主管侍衛馬軍司公事，其眾隸焉。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Sheng was made director of the Palace Horse Guard; his troops were enrolled there.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Tian Sheng was made director of the Palace Horse Guard and his men enrolled.

sentences.zh: 己酉，加錢愐太尉。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Qian Min was advanced to Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Qian Min was raised to Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔監司、守臣講求恤民事宜。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict ordered circuit intendants and prefects to investigate measures to comfort the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, intendants and prefects were told to study policies that would ease the people's burdens.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，宗室子偁卒於秀州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingsi: clansman Zicheng died in Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingsi: clansman Zicheng died at Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，洪皓出知饒州。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Hong Hao was sent out as prefect of Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Hong Hao was posted prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命諸路置敦宗院。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: all routes were ordered to establish halls for nurturing the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, every route was ordered to found halls to nurture clansmen.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔淮東、京西監司歲終上州縣所增戶口，為守令殿最。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Huai East and Jing West intendants were ordered to report year-end household increases in their prefectures as the basis for ranking prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Huai East and Jing West intendants were to report population growth at year's end to grade local officials.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以兵部侍郎司馬朴死節，贈兵部尚書，賜其家銀絹。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: because Vice Minister of War Sima Pu died loyal, he was posthumously made Minister of War and his family given silver and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Sima Pu—who died faithful—was posthumously made Minister of War; his family received silver and silk.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔諸州守、貳提舉學事，縣令、佐主管學事。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: prefects and vice-prefects were ordered to supervise schools; county magistrates and assistants to manage them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, prefects were to supervise schools and county magistrates to run them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蠲淮南逋欠坊場錢及上供帛。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Huainan's overdue market-levy money and tribute silk were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Huainan's overdue market dues and tribute silk were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，秦檜上《監學敕令格式》。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jichou: Qin Hui submitted the Regulations and Formats for Supervising Schools.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jichou: Qin Hui presented the Regulations for Supervising Schools.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，制渾天儀。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: an armillary sphere was made.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an armillary sphere was built.

sentences.zh: 乙未，奉安累朝帝后神禦于景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: spirit tablets of successive emperors and empresses were installed in the Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, spirit tablets of past emperors and empresses were enshrined in the Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，日南至，合祀天地於圜丘，太祖、太守並配，大赦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengshen: winter solstice; Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Circular Mound, Taizu and Taizong both associated; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengshen, winter solstice: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed together at the Circular Mound with Taizu and Taizong; a great amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未朔，日食，雲陰不見。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiwei new moon: solar eclipse; clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiwei new moon: an eclipse occurred but clouds concealed it.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，毀私鑄毛錢。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: privately cast wool coins were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, illicit wool coins were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，建秘書省。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the Secretariat was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the Secretariat was erected.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，增太學弟子員二百。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Imperial University student places were increased by two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, two hundred more places were added at the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 己亥，郭浩入見。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Guo Hao had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Guo Hao was received.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命行在宗子入宮學。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: clansmen at the mobile court were ordered to enter the Palace School.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, clansmen at court were ordered into the Palace School.

sentences.zh: 己酉，金遣完顏曄等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Jin sent Wanyan Ye and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the Jin sent Wanyan Ye and others to greet the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 是月，始頒來歲曆于諸路監司、守臣。

translations.literal: That month, next year's calendar was first issued to route intendants and prefects.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court first issued the next year's calendar to intendants and prefects.

sentences.zh: 是歲，關外初行營田。

translations.literal: That year, military colonies were first run beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: That year garrison farming began beyond the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月丁巳，遣羅汝楫等報謝金國。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, day dingsi: Luo Ruji and others were sent to thank the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 14, spring, dingsi: Luo Ruji and others were dispatched to thank the Jin.

sentences.zh: 甲子，臨安府火。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Lin'an prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, fire broke out in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命普安郡王為子侢解官持服。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Prince of Pu'an was ordered to resign office and observe mourning for his son Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Prince of Pu'an was told to leave his post and mourn his son Dai.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，復置靖州新民學。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Jingzhou's New People School was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: Jingzhou's school for newly submitted peoples was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，蠲江、浙諸路逋欠錢帛。

translations.literal: Day guisi: overdue money and silk on the Jiang and Zhe routes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, overdue payments in silver and silk on the Jiang and Zhe routes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，初命四川都轉運司歲撥總制司錢百七十三萬緡，市紬絹綿輸于鄂州總領所。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Sichuan's overall transport office was first ordered each year to allocate 1.73 million strings to the general commandery to buy satin, silk, and cotton for delivery to Ezhou's supply depot.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Sichuan's transport office was first told to send 1.73 million strings yearly to buy cloth for Ezhou's supply depot.

sentences.zh: 丙午，罷万俟禼。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Wan Qixie was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wan Qixie left office.

sentences.zh: 定宗學生額為百員。

translations.literal: The quota for clansmen in the Palace School was fixed at one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Palace School enrollment for clansmen was capped at one hundred.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以資政殿學士樓炤簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Academician Lou Zhao was made Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Lou Zhao became Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 加郭浩檢校少保。

translations.literal: Guo Hao was advanced to acting Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Hao was made acting Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，蠲江、浙、京、湖積欠上供錢米。

translations.literal: Third month, day yimao: accumulated tribute grain and money owed on the Jiang, Zhe, Jing, and Hu routes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yimao: long-overdue tribute grain and money on Jiang, Zhe, Jing, and Hu were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，避金太祖嫌名，改岷州為西和州，川、陝宣撫司為四川宣撫司。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: to avoid the Jin founder's taboo name, Minzhou was renamed Xihezhou and the Sichuan-Shaanxi pacification office became the Sichuan pacification office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Minzhou became Xihezhou to avoid the Jin founder's taboo; the Sichuan-Shaanxi office became the Sichuan pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸太學。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Emperor visited the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Gaozong visited the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 蠲汀、漳、泉、建四州經賊殘蹂民戶賦役一年。

translations.literal: Taxes and corvée for households ravaged by bandits in Ting, Zhang, Quan, and Jian prefectures were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: One year's taxes and labor were cut for Ting, Zhang, Quan, and Jian households still recovering from bandits.

sentences.zh: 壬申，解潛坐党趙鼎，責授濠州團練副使、南安軍安置。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Xie Qian, convicted as Zhao Ding's partisan, was demoted to Tuanlian vice commissioner of Haozhou and assigned to Nan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Xie Qian—judged Zhao Ding's man—was demoted and sent to Nan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔舉賢良。

translations.literal: Day jimao: an edict summoned men of worth and excellence.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the court called for men of worth and excellence.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，詔刑部及監司決絕滯訟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: the Ministry of Justice and circuit intendants were ordered to clear stalled lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiashen: the Ministry of Justice and route intendants were told to clear backlog cases.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，初禁野史。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: unofficial histories were first forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, private histories were banned for the first time.

sentences.zh: 虔州民析其屋，朽柱中有文曰「天下太平年」。

translations.literal: A Qianzhou man split his house; inside a rotted pillar was writing that read, "Years of great peace under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: In Qianzhou a man tore down his house and found in a rotten beam the words: "Years of great peace under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 甲午，金人來求淮北人之在南者，詔原者聽還。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Jin envoys came seeking northerners south of the Huai; an edict said those who wished might return.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Jin envoys demanded southerners who had fled north of the Huai; the court said return was voluntary.

sentences.zh: 遣馬軍司統領張守忠討海賊朱明。

translations.literal: Horse Guard commander Zhang Shouzhong was sent to suppress the sea bandit Zhu Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shouzhong of the Horse Guard was sent against the pirate Zhu Ming.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，詔階、成、西和、鳳四州募兵赴行在。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: an edict ordered Jie, Cheng, Xihe, and Feng prefectures to recruit troops for the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingchen: Jie, Cheng, Xihe, and Feng were told to recruit men for the mobile army.

sentences.zh: 甲子，樓炤罷。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Lou Zhao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lou Zhao left office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以御史中丞李文會簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Censor-in-Chief Li Wenhui was made Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Li Wenhui became Privy Council Signatory and acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，婺州大水。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: great flood in Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wuzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 己巳，金始遣烏延和等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Jin first sent Wuyanhe and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Jin for the first time sent Wuyanhe and others to greet the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 辛未，楚州鹽城縣海水清。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the sea at Yancheng county, Chuzhou, ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the sea off Yancheng in Chuzhou turned clear.

sentences.zh: 是月，嚴、信、衢、建四州水。

translations.literal: That month, Yan, Xin, Qu, and Jian prefectures flooded.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods hit Yan, Xin, Qu, and Jian.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，蠲江、浙州縣酒稅、坊場、綱運、倉庫積年逋負。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: overdue wine tax, market levies, transport fees, and warehouse debts on Jiang and Zhe prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiashen: years of overdue wine tax, market dues, transport charges, and warehouse debt in Jiang and Zhe were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 孫近再奪三官，移南安軍居住。

translations.literal: Sun Jin was again stripped of three ranks and moved to reside in Nan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jin lost three more ranks and was sent to Nan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，加高世則少保。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Gao Shize was advanced to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Gao Shize was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 戊子，安南國入貢。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Annan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Annan presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，宣州涇縣妖賊俞一作亂，守臣捕滅之。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the demon bandit Yu Yi rebelled in Jing county, Xuanzhou; the prefect suppressed and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the sorcerer-rebel Yu Yi rose in Jing county, Xuanzhou; the prefect crushed him.

sentences.zh: 乙未，振江、浙、福建被水之民。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: victims of flood in Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, flood victims in Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙申，內侍白鄂坐誹謗，及其客張伯麟俱黥配吉陽軍。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: eunuch Bai E, convicted of slander, and his guest Zhang Bolin were both tattooed and banished to Jiyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the eunuch Bai E and his client Zhang Bolin—convicted of slander—were tattooed and sent to Jiyang Army.

sentences.zh: 特贈子偁太子少師，官給葬事。

translations.literal: Clansman Zicheng was specially posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent; the state supplied the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent at state expense.

sentences.zh: 庚子，奪万俟禼三官、歸州居住。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Wan Qixie was stripped of three ranks and ordered to reside in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wan Qixie lost three ranks and was sent to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，置國子監小學。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the Directorate of Education's primary school was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Directorate's primary school was founded.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，金人殺王倫於河間府。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuwu: the Jin killed Wang Lun at Hejian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wuwu: the Jin executed Wang Lun at Hejian.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，立明法科兼經法。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Statutes Examination was established, combining statutory and classical law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Statutes Examination was created, pairing code and classical law.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸秘書省。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Emperor visited the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Gaozong visited the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，撫州獻瑞禾。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiwei: Fuzhou presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guiwei: Fuzhou offered auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以李椿年權戶部侍郎，仍治經界。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Li Chunnian was made acting Vice Minister of Revenue and continued to oversee the field-boundary project.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Li Chunnian became acting Vice Minister of Revenue and kept charge of the land survey.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣林保使金賀正旦，宋之才賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Lin Bao was sent to the Jin to congratulate the New Year; Song Zhicai the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Lin Bao greeted the Jin New Year; Song Zhicai the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，分利州為東、西路，以吳璘為利州西路安撫使，楊政利州東路安撫使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: Lizhou was divided into East and West circuits; Wu Lin was made Lizhou West pacification commissioner, Yang Zheng Lizhou East.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinyou: Lizhou was split east and west; Wu Lin pacified the west, Yang Zheng the east.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命郡守終更入見，各舉所部縣令一人。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: prefects at the end of their terms were ordered to have audience; each was to recommend one magistrate from his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, outgoing prefects were received at court and each told to nominate one county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 壬申，趙鼎移吉陽軍安置。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Zhao Ding was moved to Jiyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhao Ding was transferred to Jiyang Army.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命臨安府索蔡京子孫逮赴貶所，遇赦永不量移。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Lin'an prefecture was ordered to seize Cai Jing's descendants and send them to exile; amnesties would never recall them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Lin'an was told to hunt down Cai Jing's kin and exile them beyond any future amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，從右正言何若言，請戒內外師儒之官，黜伊川程氏之學。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu: following Right Remonstrator He Ruo's memorial, teachers inside and outside the palace were admonished and the learning of the Yichuan Cheng clan was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiawu: on He Ruo's advice, tutors were warned and the Yichuan Cheng school was driven from court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，加韋淵少師。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Wei Yuan was advanced to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Wei Yuan was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以永、道、郴三州、桂陽監及茶陵縣民多不舉子，永蠲其身丁錢絹米麥。

translations.literal: Day jihai: because the people of Yong, Dao, Chen prefectures, Guiyang Garrison, and Chaling county largely did not rear sons, their personal head-tax in money, silk, rice, and wheat was permanently remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, because families in Yong, Dao, Chen, Guiyang, and Chaling seldom raised sons, their head-tax in cash and grain was abolished forever.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月丁未朔，禦大慶殿，初行大朝會禮。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, day dingwei new moon: the Emperor held court in the Great Celebration Hall and first performed the great audience rite.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 15, spring, dingwei new moon: Gaozong held the great audience in the Great Celebration Hall for the first time.

sentences.zh: 戊申，瀘南安撫使馮楫獻嘉禾。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Luzhou pacification commissioner Feng Ji presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Feng Ji of Luzhou offered auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 己未，分經義、詩賦為兩科取士。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: classical meaning and fu poetry were separated into two examination tracks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the examinations split classical meaning and fu poetry into separate degrees.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，初置籍田。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the sacred field was first established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the emperor's sacred plowing field was first laid out.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，減成都府路對糴米三之一、宣撫司激賞錢三十萬緡。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Chengdu circuit's harmonized-purchase rice was reduced by one-third and the pacification office's reward fund by three hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Chengdu's harmonized-purchase rice was cut by a third and the pacification reward fund by three hundred thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命戶部侍郎王鈇措置兩浙經界。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Fu was ordered to arrange the field-boundary project in the two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wang Fu was told to carry out the land survey in the two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 辛未，初命僧道納免丁錢。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: monks and Daoist priests were first ordered to pay exemption-from-corvée money.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, monks and Daoists were first required to pay corvée exemption fees.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，增太學弟子員百人。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: Imperial University student places were increased by one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuyin: one hundred more places were added at the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔州縣科折之數，第三等戶毋或均配。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict said that in prefectural and county apportionments, third-grade households must not be assigned equal shares.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, counties were told not to levy third-grade households at the same rate as the wealthy.

sentences.zh: 己亥，封崇國公璩為恩平郡王，出就第。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Venerating-State Duke Shen was enfeoffed Prince of Enping and ordered to leave the palace for his mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Venerating-State Duke Shen was created Prince of Enping and moved to his own residence.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，遣敷文閣待制周襟、馬觀國、史願、諸將程師回、馬欽、白常皆還金國。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: Awaiting-Text Pavilion Gentlemen Zhou Jin, Ma Guanguo, Shi Yuan, and generals Cheng Shihui, Ma Qin, and Bai Chang were all returned to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiazi: Zhou Jin, Ma Guanguo, Shi Yuan, and generals Cheng Shihui, Ma Qin, and Bai Chang were all sent back to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，賜秦檜第一區。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingzi new moon: Qin Hui was granted a first-rank mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingzi new moon: Qin Hui received a first-rank residence.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，彗星出東方。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a comet rose in the east.

sentences.zh: 癸未，避殿減膳，命監司、郡守條上便民事宜，提刑巡行決獄。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the Emperor left the hall, reduced meals, ordered intendants and prefects to list policies that would benefit the people, and judicial commissioners to tour circuits and decide cases.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Gaozong left the hall and ate sparingly; intendants were to propose reforms and judicial commissioners to ride circuit judging cases.

sentences.zh: 賜禮部進士劉章以下三百人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Presented Scholar Liu Zhang and three hundred others were granted jinshi degrees and passes.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhang and three hundred others received jinshi degrees and passes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以彗出，大赦。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because a comet had appeared, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, a comet brought a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，彗沒。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣後軍統制張淵討捕福建盜賊。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Rear Army commander Zhang Yuan was sent to suppress bandits in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhang Yuan of the Rear Army was sent against Fujian bandits.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷四川都轉運司。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Sichuan's overall transport office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Sichuan's overall transport commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，客星見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: a guest star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingchen: a guest star was seen.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命貧民產子賜義倉米一斛。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: poor families bearing sons were granted one hu of charity-granary grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, poor households that bore sons received one hu from the charity granary.

sentences.zh: 甲子，金遣完顏宗尹等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the Jin sent Wanyan Zongyin and others to congratulate the Tian Shen festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Jin sent Wanyan Zongyin and others for the Tian Shen festival.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yihai new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸秦檜第。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the Emperor visited Qin Hui's residence.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Emperor visited Qin Hui's home.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，加檜妻婦子孫官封。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: offices and enfeoffments were added for Qin Hui's wife, son, and grandchildren.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Qin Hui's wife, son, and grandchildren received added offices and titles.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，客星沒。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the guest star vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the guest star disappeared.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，復置利州鑄錢監。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: the Lizhou coin mint was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wushen: the Lizhou coin mint was restored.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命監司審查縣令治狀顯著及老懦不職者，上其名以為黜陟。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: circuit commissioners were ordered to review magistrates with notable governance and those old or incompetent, and submit names for promotion and dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, circuit commissioners were to review magistrates who governed well or were old or unfit and report names for promotion or removal.

sentences.zh: 蠲廬、光二州上供錢米一年。

translations.literal: Lu and Guang prefectures' tribute money and grain were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Lu and Guang were exempted from one year of tribute money and grain.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，免汀、漳二州秋稅及處州三縣被水民家紬絹，鄂州舊額絹各一年。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: autumn tax of Ting and Zhang prefectures and three Chu prefecture counties hit by flood was exempted, and one year of E prefecture's quota silk.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, autumn tax was cut for flood-hit Ting, Zhang, and three Chu counties, and E's quota silk for one year.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蠲四川轉運司積貸常平錢十三萬緡。

translations.literal: Day jisi: thirteen hundred thousand strings of Sichuan transport's accumulated Ever-Normal loans were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, 1.3 million strings of Sichuan transport's piled-up Ever-Normal debt were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月申戌朔，禁收折帛合零錢，止輸實數。

translations.literal: Eighth month, shenxu new moon: collecting combined fractional silk-cash payments was forbidden; only actual amounts were to be paid.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, shenxu new moon: fractional silk-cash lump sums were banned; only full amounts could be collected.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蠲京西路請佃田租及州縣場務稅錢二年。

translations.literal: Day yihai: two years of Jingxi circuit tenant-rent requests and prefectural market taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Jingxi tenant-rent claims and market taxes were forgiven for two years.

sentences.zh: 己亥，改諸路提舉茶鹽官為提舉常平茶鹽公事，川、廣以憲臣兼領。

translations.literal: Day jihai: circuit tea-salt commissioners were renamed Ever-Normal tea-salt commissioners; in Sichuan and Guang the judicial commissioners held the post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, circuit tea-salt posts became Ever-Normal tea-salt offices; in Sichuan and Guang judicial commissioners doubled as chiefs.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復增太學弟子員二百。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Imperial Academy students were again increased by two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the academy added two hundred students.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，遣錢周材使金賀正旦，嚴抑賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: Qian Zhoucai was sent as envoy to the Jin for New Year's; congratulating the Jin ruler's birthday was strictly restrained.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinyou: Qian Zhoucai went to the Jin for New Year's; envoys were tightly barred from the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，帝書「一德格天之閣」賜秦檜，仍就第賜宴。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yihai: the Emperor wrote "Hall of One Virtue Matching Heaven" and gave it to Qin Hui, and feasted at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yihai: the Emperor inscribed "Hall of One Virtue Matching Heaven" for Qin Hui and held a feast at his house.

sentences.zh: 丙子，楊願罷。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Yang Yuan left office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Yang Yuan left office.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以樞密都承旨李若穀簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Privy Council chief Liu Ruogu was made signatory of the Privy Council and acting Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Privy Council chief Liu Ruogu became Privy Council signatory and acting Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 武岡軍徭人楊再興降。

translations.literal: Wugong army Yao man Yang Zaixing surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Wugong Yao leader Yang Zaixing surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以翰林學士承旨秦熺為資政殿學士、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀，恩數視執政。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Hanlin academician-in-chief Qin Xi was made Zizheng Hall academician, commissioner of Longevity Abbey and reader-in-waiting, with privileges equal to chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Hanlin chief Qin Xi became Zizheng Hall academician, Longevity Abbey commissioner and reader, with chief-minister privileges.

sentences.zh: 辛卯夜，雷。

translations.literal: Night of day xinmao: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinmao, thunder.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，蠲安豐軍上供錢米二年。

translations.literal: Day guisi: two years of Anfeng army tribute money and grain were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Anfeng's tribute money and grain were cut for two years.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以汪勃言折彥質党趙鼎，郴州安置。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: on Wang Bo's charge that Zhe Yanzhi was Zhao Ding's partisan, he was exiled to Chen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wang Bo said Zhe Yanzhi belonged to Zhao Ding's faction; he was sent to Chen prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，置四川宣撫司總領錢糧官。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Sichuan Pacification Commission's grain-supply chief was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Sichuan Pacification got a grain-supply chief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命秦熺班簽書樞密之下。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Qin Xi was ordered to rank in court below the Privy Council signatory.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Qin Xi was placed in court below the Privy Council signatory.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，加錢忱少保，錢愐開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiachen: Qian Chen was promoted to Junior Guardian and Qian Min to Palatine Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiachen: Qian Chen became Junior Guardian and Qian Min Palatine Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，郭浩卒。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Guo Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Guo Hao died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，全給秦檜歲賜公使錢萬緡。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Qin Hui's full annual grant of ten thousand strings public envoy money was given.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Qin Hui received his full yearly ten thousand strings of envoy funds.

sentences.zh: 閏月己卯，罷明法新科。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jimao: the new law-examination curriculum was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jimao: the new law-exam track was ended.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，置江陰軍市舶務。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu: the Jiangyin army maritime trade office was established.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuwu: Jiangyin army opened a maritime trade office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命右司員外郎李朝正同措置經界。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Right Office vice director Li Chaozheng was ordered jointly to arrange land boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Right Office vice director Li Chaozheng was told to arrange land boundaries.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，金遣蒲察說等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Jin sent Pucha Shuo and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Jin sent Pucha Shuo and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月戊子，增太學外舍生額至千人。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, spring, first month, day wuzi: outer academy student quota was raised to one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Year 16, first month, wuzi: outer academy places rose to one thousand.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，親饗先農於東郊，行籍田禮，執耒耜九推，詔告郡縣。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the Emperor personally offered to Former Agriculture at the eastern suburb, performed the ceremonial plowing, pushed the plow nine times, and an edict announced this to prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Emperor sacrificed to Former Agriculture east of the capital, plowed ceremonially nine furrows, and ordered prefectures notified.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，割金州豐陽縣、洋州乾祐縣畀金人。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinchou: Fengyang county of Jin prefecture and Qianyou county of Yang prefecture were ceded to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, xinchou: Jin's Fengyang and Yang's Qianyou counties went to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，毀諸路淫祠。

translations.literal: Day renyin: illicit shrines on every circuit were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, illicit shrines circuit-wide were torn down.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，建秦檜家廟。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Qin Hui's family temple was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Qin Hui's ancestral temple was built.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午朔，建武學，置弟子員百人。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu new moon: the Military Academy was founded with one hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengwu new moon: the Military Academy opened with one hundred students.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，造秦檜家廟祭器。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: ritual vessels for Qin Hui's family temple were made.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, temple vessels were cast for Qin Hui's shrine.

sentences.zh: 乙未，增建太廟。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Imperial Ancestral Temple was expanded.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the ancestral temple was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 己亥，立淮東、江東、兩浙、湖北州縣歲較營田賞罰格。

translations.literal: Day jihai: annual reward-and-punishment standards for camp farming in Huaidong, Jiangdong, two Zhe circuits, and Hubei prefectures and counties were set.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, yearly camp-farm reward and penalty rules were fixed for Huaidong, Jiangdong, two Zhes, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，禁州縣預借民稅及和買錢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi: prefectures and counties were forbidden to advance-borrow civilian taxes and requisition purchase money.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renzi: prefectures could not advance-borrow taxes or requisition purchase funds.

sentences.zh: 戊午，定選試武士弓馬去留格。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: standards for selecting and testing military scholars' archery and horsemanship were set.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, rules for testing military students' bow and horse skills were set.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，浚運河。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renshen: the transport canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renshen: the transport canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 命諸路漕臣兼提舉學事。

translations.literal: Circuit transport commissioners were ordered concurrently to supervise schools.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit transport chiefs were also made school superintendents.

sentences.zh: 癸未，初作太廟祏室。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the ancestral temple spirit chambers were first built.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the temple spirit chambers were first built.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，作景鐘。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Splendid Bell was cast.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Splendid Bell was cast.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，金遣烏古論海等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Jin sent Wugulun Hai and others to congratulate the Heavenly Succession Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Jin sent Wugulun Hai and others for the Heavenly Succession Festival.

sentences.zh: 六月，安南獻馴象十。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Annam presented ten tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Annam sent ten tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，以張浚上疏論時事，落節鉞、連州居住。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: because Zhang Jun memorialized on current affairs, his command tally was removed and he was made to reside at Lian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: Zhang Jun's memorial on affairs cost him his command tally; he was sent to Lian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，立秘書省獻書賞格。

translations.literal: Day renchen: reward standards for presenting books to the Secretariat were set.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Secretariat book-donation rewards were fixed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，復何鑄為端明殿學士兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: He Zhu was again made Zhaoming Hall academician and reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, He Zhu again became Zhaoming Hall academician and reader.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，築高禖壇。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou: the High Mound altar was built.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinchou: the High Mound altar was built.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣邊知白使金賀正旦，周執羔賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Bian Zhibai was sent as envoy to the Jin for New Year's and Zhou Zhigao to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Bian Zhibai went to the Jin for New Year's and Zhou Zhigao for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，命何鑄等為金國祈請使，請國族。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: He Zhu and others were made Jin petition envoys to request the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiaxu: He Zhu and others were sent to the Jin to plead for the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賞統制張淵、韓京等討捕福建、廣東諸盜功，各進官有差。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Zhang Yuan, Han Jing, and others were rewarded for suppressing bandits in Fujian and Guangdong; each was promoted by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhang Yuan, Han Jing, and others were promoted for crushing Fujian and Guangdong bandits.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，帝觀新作禮器於射殿，撞景鐘，奏新樂。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: the Emperor viewed the new ritual vessels in the Archery Hall, struck the Splendid Bell, and heard the new music.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuxu: the Emperor inspected new ritual gear in the Archery Hall, rang the Splendid Bell, and heard new music.

sentences.zh: 十一日丙子，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Intercalary eleventh month, day bingzi: heaven and earth were jointly sacrificed at the Round Mound; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary eleventh month, bingzi: heaven and earth were sacrificed together at the Round Mound and there was a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷州縣新創稅場。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: newly created tax stations in prefectures and counties were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, new tax stations in prefectures and counties were shut.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復置禦書院。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Imperial Writings Academy was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Imperial Writings Academy was restored.

sentences.zh: 己丑，加潘正夫少保。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Pan Zhengfu was promoted to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Pan Zhengfu became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，彗見西南方，乙巳，滅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuxu: a comet appeared in the southwest; on day yisi it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuxu: a comet showed in the southwest; on yisi it faded.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，金遣盧彥倫等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the Jin sent Lu Yanlun and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Jin sent Lu Yanlun and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月己巳，命諸路收試中原流寓士人。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, spring, first month, day jisi: every circuit was ordered to test refugee scholars from the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: Year 17, first month, jisi: circuits were told to examine Central Plains refugee scholars.

sentences.zh: 己卯，禁監司、郡守進羨餘。

translations.literal: Day jimao: circuit commissioners and prefects were forbidden to present surplus tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, circuit chiefs and prefects could not send surplus tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以舉人多冒貫，命州縣每三歲行鄉飲酒禮以貢士。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: because many candidates used false registers, prefectures and counties were ordered every three years to hold village drinking rites to recommend scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, with widespread false registers, prefectures were told to hold triennial village rites to recommend scholars.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以李若穀參知政事，御史中丞何若簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Li Ruogu was made Vice Councilor and Censor-in-chief He Ruo signatory of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Li Ruogu became Vice Councilor and Censor-in-chief He Ruo Privy Council signatory.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，進秦熺為資政殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Qin Xi was advanced to Grand Zizheng Hall academician.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Qin Xi was raised to Grand Zizheng Hall academician.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，親祠高禖。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: the Emperor personally sacrificed at the High Mound.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yisi: the Emperor sacrificed at the High Mound in person.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，李若穀罷。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Li Ruogu left office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Li Ruogu left office.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，何若罷。

translations.literal: Third month, day yihai: He Ruo left office.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yihai: He Ruo left office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以翰林學士段拂參知政事。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Hanlin academician Duan Fu was made Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Hanlin academician Duan Fu became Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改封秦檜為益國公。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Qin Hui's enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Qin Hui was retitled Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 戊子，改命張俊為靜江、甯武、靖海軍節度使，韓世忠鎮南、武安、甯國軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zhang Jun was reassigned military commissioner of Jingjiang, Ningwu, and Jinghai armies, and Han Shizhong of Zhennan, Wu'an, and Ningguo armies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhang Jun took Jingjiang, Ningwu, and Jinghai commands and Han Shizhong Zhennan, Wu'an, and Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 落李若谷資政殿學士、江州居住。

translations.literal: Li Ruogu was stripped of Zizheng Hall academician and made to reside at Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ruogu lost Zizheng Hall rank and was sent to Jiang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，蠲諸路免行錢三之一。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingshen: one-third of every circuit's exemption fees was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingshen: one-third of circuit exemption fees was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以御史中丞汪勃簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Censor-in-chief Wang Bo was made signatory of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Censor-in-chief Wang Bo became Privy Council signatory.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔趙鼎遇赦永不檢舉。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict said Zhao Ding would never be considered at any amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, an edict barred Zhao Ding from every future amnesty.

sentences.zh: 以前貶所潮州錄事參軍石恮待遇鼎厚，除名、潯州編管。

translations.literal: Former Chaozhou registrar Shi Hui, who had treated Ding generously in exile, was removed from office and registered at Xun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hui, a former Chaozhou registrar who had favored Ding in exile, was struck from the rolls and sent to Xun prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，詔舉賢良。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: an edict called for recommending worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiazi: the court called for worthy recommendations.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day yichou: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，洪皓責濠州團練副使、英州安置。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Hong Hao was demoted to Haozhou militia vice commissioner and exiled to Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Hong Hao was cut to Haozhou militia deputy and sent to Ying prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金遣完顏卞等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the Jin sent Wanyan Bian and others to congratulate the Heavenly Succession Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Jin sent Wanyan Bian and others for the Heavenly Succession Festival.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，禁招安盜賊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: recruiting and pardoning bandits was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yimao: recruiting and pardoning bandits was banned.

sentences.zh: 戊午，改命普安郡王瑗為常德軍節度使，恩平郡王璩武康軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Prince of Pu'an Jun was reassigned military commissioner of Changde army and Prince of Enping Jun of Wukang army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Prince of Pu'an became Changde military commissioner and the Prince of Enping Wukang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，召鄭剛中赴行在。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengchen: Zheng Gangzhong was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengchen: Zheng Gangzhong was called to court.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 以徽猷閣待制、知成都府李璆權四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: Huizhen Hall awaiting appointment and Chengdu prefect Li Qiao was made acting Sichuan Pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiao of Huizhen Hall, Chengdu prefect, became acting Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命李璆同總領四川財賦符行中參酌減放四川重斂。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Li Qiao was ordered with overall Sichuan finance chief Fu Xingzhong to consider reducing Sichuan's heavy levies.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Qiao and Sichuan finance chief Fu Xingzhong were told to study cutting Sichuan's heavy taxes.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以吳璘充御前諸軍都統制兼知興州。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wu Lin was made overall commander of the imperial guard and concurrent prefect of Xing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Wu Lin commanded the imperial guard and also governed Xing.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，罷建州創置賣鹽坊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: Jian prefecture's newly created salt shops were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengzi: Jian's new salt shops were closed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，趙鼎薨于吉陽軍。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Zhao Ding died at Jiyang army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhao Ding died at Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遣沈該使金賀正旦，詹大方賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Shen Gai was sent as envoy to the Jin for New Year's and Zhan Dafang to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Shen Gai went to the Jin for New Year's and Zhan Dafang for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以諸路羨余錢充月樁之數。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: surplus money from every circuit was made to cover monthly quota payments.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, circuit surplus funds were assigned to monthly quotas.

sentences.zh: 加邢孝揚太尉。

translations.literal: Xing Xiaoyang was promoted to Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Xiaoyang became Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，減四川科率虛額錢歲二百八十五萬緡。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: Sichuan's nominal levy money was cut by two million eight hundred fifty thousand strings yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jisi: Sichuan's paper levy was cut by 2.85 million strings a year.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔以四川宣撫司降賜庫米一百萬石，均減對糴。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict used one million shi of grain from the Sichuan Pacification Commission's bestowal store to reduce paired grain purchases evenly.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, one million shi from Sichuan Pacification stores was ordered to ease paired grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，蠲江南東、西道諸州月樁錢。

translations.literal: Day yihai: monthly quota money in Jiangnan east and west circuits was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, monthly quota money in east and west Jiangnan was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙子，鄭剛中罷。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Zheng Gangzhong left office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Zheng Gangzhong left office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，減江、浙諸州折帛錢。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: silk-cash payments in Jiang and Zhe prefectures were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, silk-cash dues in Jiang and Zhe prefectures were cut.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinmao new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinmao new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，建太一宮。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Great Unity Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Great Unity Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命太常歲以春秋二仲薦獻欑宮，季秋遣御史按視。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the Directorate of Ritual was ordered each year at the two mid-seasons to offer at the spirit hall, and in late autumn to send censors to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Ritual Office was told to offer at the spirit hall each spring and autumn mid-month and send censors each late autumn.

sentences.zh: 己酉，進楊存中為少傅。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Yang Cunzhong was advanced to Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Yang Cunzhong became Junior Mentor.

sentences.zh: 己未，臨安府甘露降。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: sweet dew fell in Lin'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, sweet dew fell in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，秦檜上《重修免役敕令格式》。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingyin: Qin Hui presented the Revised Exemption-Service Edicts and Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingyin: Qin Hui submitted the Revised Exemption-Service Edicts and Regulations.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復賜進士聞喜宴。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the celebratory feast for new jinshi graduates was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the jinshi celebration feast was restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯朔，禁諸州擅釋放流配命官及事幹邊防切要之人。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao new moon: prefectures were forbidden on their own to release exiled officials and persons involved in urgent frontier matters.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinmao new moon: prefectures could not on their own free exiled officials or men tied to urgent frontier cases.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，鄭剛中落職、桂陽監居住。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Zheng Gangzhong was stripped of office and made to reside at Guiyang prison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zheng Gangzhong lost office and was sent to Guiyang prison.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金遣完顏宗藩等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin sent Wanyan Zongfan and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Jin sent Wanyan Zongfan and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月己巳，幸天竺寺，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, spring, first month, day jisi: the Emperor visited Tianzhu Temple, then the Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: Year 18, first month, jisi: the Emperor visited Tianzhu Temple, then Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，段拂罷，尋落職、興國軍居住。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: Duan Fu left office and soon was stripped of office and made to reside at Xingguo army.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiwei: Duan Fu left office, then lost rank and was sent to Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 以汪勃兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Wang Bo was made acting Vice Councilor concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo also became acting Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，聽趙鼎歸葬。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhao Ding's burial was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhao Ding was allowed burial.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，命楊政、吳璘招關、陝流民補殿前軍。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: Yang Zheng and Wu Lin were ordered to recruit Guan and Shaanxi refugee commoners to fill the Palace Front Army.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingchou: Yang Zheng and Wu Lin were told to recruit Guan and Shaanxi refugees into the Palace Front Army.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷汀州諸縣上供銀，蠲茶鉛本錢之半。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Ting prefecture counties' tribute silver was abolished and half of tea-lead capital was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Ting counties stopped tribute silver and half of tea-lead capital was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，幸新太一宮。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Emperor visited the new Great Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Emperor visited the new Great Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以秦熺知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Qin Xi was made Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Qin Xi became Privy Councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，禁民私渡淮及招納叛亡。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: civilians were forbidden to cross the Huai privately and to harbor defectors.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, private Huai crossings and harboring defectors were banned.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuzi new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，秦熺乞避父子共政，以為觀文殿學士、提舉萬壽觀兼侍讀、提舉秘書省。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Qin Xi begged to avoid father and son sharing government and was made Wensu Hall academician, commissioner of Longevity Abbey and reader-in-waiting, and supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Qin Xi asked to step back from ruling with his father and became Wensu Hall academician, Longevity Abbey commissioner, reader, and Secretariat supervisor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命熺恩禮視宰臣班次，亞右僕射。
