translations.literal: Day renyin: Xi was ordered ceremonial honors equal to chief ministers in court rank, below the Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Xi was given chief-minister honors in court, ranking below the Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜禮部進士王佐以下三百三十人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: three hundred thirty graduates including jinshi Wang Zuo and below were given passage and origin degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, 330 men including jinshi Wang Zuo received passage and origin degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，加士夽開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Shi Fu was promoted to Palatine Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Shi Fu became Palatine Secretary.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，加吳益太尉。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: Wu Yi was promoted to Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuchen: Wu Yi became Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，裁損奉使賞給。

translations.literal: Day yihai: rewards for envoys were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, envoy rewards were trimmed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，金遣蕭秉溫等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Jin sent Xiao Bingwen and others to congratulate the Heavenly Succession Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Jin sent Xiao Bingwen and others for the Heavenly Succession Festival.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以李顯忠私取故妻于金，降為平海軍承宣使、台州居住。

translations.literal: Day guimao: because Li Xianzhong privately took back his former wife from the Jin, he was demoted to Pinghai army commissioner and made to reside at Tai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Li Xianzhong privately reclaimed his ex-wife from the Jin and was cut to Pinghai commissioner and sent to Tai prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲申，罷四川宣撫司，以李璆為四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished and Li Qiao was made Sichuan pacification and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Sichuan Pacification was ended and Li Qiao became Sichuan pacification and disposition commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，徽州慶雲見。

translations.literal: That month: auspicious clouds appeared in Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huizhou saw auspicious clouds.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，築九宮貴神壇於東郊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits altar was built at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiachen: the Nine Palaces Noble Spirits altar was built east of the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，士民曹溥等上尊號，不許。

translations.literal: Day wushen: commoners Cao Pu and others offered a honorific title; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, commoners led by Cao Pu offered a honorific title; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣太府丞宋仲堪詣江州置獄，鞫鄭剛中欺隱官錢。

translations.literal: That month: Palace Storehouse aide Song Zhongkan was sent to Jiang prefecture to set up a prison and try Zheng Gangzhong for concealing official funds.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Palace Storehouse aide Song Zhongkan went to Jiang prefecture to try Zheng Gangzhong for hiding public money.

sentences.zh: 福州候官縣有竹實如米，饑民採食之。

translations.literal: In Houguan county, Fuzhou, bamboo bore fruit like grain and hungry people gathered it to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou's Houguan county had bamboo fruit like grain; the hungry gathered it to eat.

sentences.zh: 是夏，浙東西、淮南、江東旱。

translations.literal: That summer: east and west Zhe, Huainan, and Jiangdong suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, east and west Zhe, Huainan, and Jiangdong had drought.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，汪勃罷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen: Wang Bo left office.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingshen: Wang Bo left office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以工部尚書詹大方簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Works Minister Zhan Dafang was made signatory of the Privy Council and acting Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Works Minister Zhan Dafang became Privy Council signatory and acting Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 禁州縣士民飾詞舉留官吏。

translations.literal: Prefectural scholars and commoners were forbidden to use flowery petitions to detain officials.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural scholars and commoners could not use ornate petitions to keep officials in post.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，免江、浙、湖南今歲和糴。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day gengshen: this year's requisitioned grain purchases in Jiang, Zhe, and Hunan were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, gengshen: requisitioned grain purchases in Jiang, Zhe, and Hunan were waived this year.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命臨安、平江二府、淮東西、湖北三總領所歲糴米百二十萬石，以廣儲蓄。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Lin'an and Pingjiang prefectures and the three Huai and Hubei overall supply offices were ordered yearly to purchase one million two hundred thousand shi of grain to expand reserves.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lin'an, Pingjiang, and the three Huai and Hubei supply offices were told to buy 1.2 million shi yearly for reserves.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣王墨卿使金賀正旦，陳誠之賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Wang Moqing was sent as envoy to the Jin for New Year's and Chen Chengzhi to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Wang Moqing went to the Jin for New Year's and Chen Chengzhi for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 甲申，辛道宗降官、房州羈管。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Xin Daozong was demoted and detained at Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Xin Daozong was demoted and held at Fang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，禁奉使三節人出境博易。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: envoys on the three festival missions were forbidden to trade across the border.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, festival envoys could not trade outside the border.

sentences.zh: 福建諸州賊平，以所創招奇兵為殿前司左翼軍。

translations.literal: When Fujian prefectural bandits were pacified, the newly raised Odd Troops were made the Palace Front Army's Left Wing.
translations.idiomatic: After Fujian bandits were crushed, the new Odd Troops became the Palace Front Army Left Wing.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，詹大方薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: Zhan Dafang died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingwu: Zhan Dafang died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，以御史中丞餘堯弼簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: Censor-in-chief Yu Yaobi was made signatory of the Privy Council and acting Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingchen: Censor-in-chief Yu Yaobi became Privy Council signatory and acting Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉朔，升感生帝為上祀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou new moon: the Life-Giving Emperor was raised to supreme sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yiyou new moon: the Life-Giving Emperor was promoted to supreme rite.

sentences.zh: 己亥，胡銓移吉陽軍編管。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Hu Quan was moved to registered exile at Jiyang army.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Hu Quan was sent to registered exile at Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，鄭剛中責濠州團練副使、復州安置。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zheng Gangzhong was demoted to Haozhou militia vice commissioner and exiled to Fu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zheng Gangzhong was cut to Haozhou militia deputy and sent to Fu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊申，禁四川買馬官吏私市蠻馬。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Sichuan horse-purchase officials were forbidden to buy barbarian horses privately.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Sichuan horse buyers could not privately purchase tribal horses.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，振紹興府饑。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: famine relief was given in Shaoxing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Shaoxing received famine relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯朔，振明、越、秀、潤、徽、婺、饒、信諸州流民。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yimao new moon: refugees were relieved in Ming, Yue, Xiu, Run, Hui, Wu, Rao, and Xin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yimao new moon: refugees were aided in Ming, Yue, Xiu, Run, Hui, Wu, Rao, and Xin.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，借給被災農民春耕費。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: spring-plowing funds were lent to disaster-hit farmers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, spring-plowing loans went to farmers hit by disaster.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命利路三都統措置營田，以其租充減免對糴之數。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the three overall commanders of Li circuit were ordered to arrange camp farming, using its rent to cover reduced paired grain purchases.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Li circuit's three commanders were told to run camp farms whose rent would offset eased paired grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，蠲被災下戶積欠租稅。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: accumulated tax arrears of disaster-hit lower households were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, tax arrears of disaster-hit poor households were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金遣召守忠等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Jin sent Zhao Shouzhong and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Jin sent Zhao Shouzhong and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月甲申朔，以皇太后年七十，帝詣慈甯殿行慶壽禮。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, spring, first month, day jiashen new moon: because the Empress Dowager was seventy, the Emperor went to Cining Hall to perform a birthday celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Year 19, first month, jiashen new moon: with the Empress Dowager at seventy, the Emperor celebrated at Cining Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷國信所回易北貨。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Credentials Office's north-goods exchange trade was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Credentials Office stopped trading northern goods.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，幸天竺寺，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Emperor visited Tianzhu Temple, then the Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Emperor visited Tianzhu Temple, then Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，禁湖北溪洞用人祭鬼及造蛊毒，犯者保甲同坐。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: Hubei stream-cave people were forbidden to use human sacrifice to ghosts or make gu poison; violators' mutual-responsibility groups were punished together.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingchou: Hubei cave people could not sacrifice humans to ghosts or brew gu; neighbors shared punishment.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guimao new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄭剛中移封州安置，子良嗣等亦除名編管。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Zheng Gangzhong was moved to exile at Feng prefecture; his son Liangsi and others were also removed from office and registered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zheng Gangzhong was sent to Feng prefecture; son Liangsi and others were struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，立孳生牧馬監賞罰格。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingsi: reward-and-punishment standards for breeding-horse pastures were set.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingsi: breeding-horse pasture reward and penalty rules were set.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，秘閣修撰張邵上秦檜在金國代徽宗與粘罕書稿，詔付史館，以邵為徽猷閣待制。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Secretariat reviser Zhang Shao presented Qin Hui's draft letters for Emperor Huizong to Nianhan in Jin territory; the edict sent them to the History Office and Shao was made Huizhen Hall awaiting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhang Shao gave the History Office Qin Hui's drafts to Nianhan for Huizong; Shao became Huizhen Hall awaiting appointment.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，湖、廣、江西路、建康府並甘露降。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: sweet dew fell in Hu, Guang, Jiangxi circuits and Jian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, sweet dew fell in Hu, Guang, Jiangxi, and Jian.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，汀、漳、泉三州民田被賊蹂踐，蠲其二稅。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renwu new moon: civilian fields in Ting, Zhang, and Quan three prefectures trampled by bandits had both tax payments remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renwu new moon: both taxes were cut for Ting, Zhang, and Quan fields trampled by bandits.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賞平福建群盜功，以選鋒軍統制劉寶為武泰軍承宣使，餘將士遷秩有差。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: for pacifying Fujian bandits, Vanguard Army controller Liu Bao was made Wutai army commissioner; other officers were promoted by rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Liu Bao of the Vanguard Army became Wutai commissioner for crushing Fujian bandits; other officers were promoted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，金遣唐括德溫等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Jin sent Tangkuo Dewen and others to congratulate the Heavenly Succession Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Jin sent Tangkuo Dewen and others for the Heavenly Succession Festival.

sentences.zh: 丁未，減連、英、循、惠、新、恩六州免行錢。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: exemption fees in Lian, Ying, Xun, Hui, Xin, and En six prefectures were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, exemption fees were cut in Lian, Ying, Xun, Hui, Xin, and En.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，茶陵縣丞王庭珪作詩送胡銓，坐謗訕停官、辰州編管。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: Chaling county aide Wang Tinggui wrote a poem seeing off Hu Quan and, for slander, was suspended and registered at Chen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingsi: Chaling aide Wang Tinggui's farewell poem for Hu Quan cost him his post for slander; he was sent to Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊午，秦檜上《吏部續降七司通用法》。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Qin Hui presented the Ministry of Personnel's Continued General Regulations for Seven Offices.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Qin Hui submitted the Ministry's Continued General Regulations for Seven Offices.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，頒諸農書於郡邑。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renyin: agricultural books were issued to prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renyin: farming manuals were sent to prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，刺浙東諸州強盜當配者充沿海諸軍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: strong robbers in eastern Zhe due for banishment were tattooed and assigned to coastal armies.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinwei: eastern Zhe robbers marked for exile were tattooed into coastal armies.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，命繪秦檜像，仍作贊賜之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: an order was given to paint Qin Hui's portrait and compose a eulogy to bestow on him.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wushen: the court ordered Qin Hui's portrait painted and a eulogy written for him.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，湖南副總管辛永宗停官、肇慶府編管。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiwei: Hunan deputy overall commander Xin Yongzong was suspended and registered at Zhaoqing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiwei: Hunan deputy commander Xin Yongzong was suspended and sent to Zhaoqing.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renchen: heaven and earth were jointly sacrificed at the Round Mound; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renchen: heaven and earth were sacrificed at the Round Mound and there was a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李椿年以經界不均罷。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Li Chunnian left office over unequal land boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Li Chunnian left office because land boundaries were uneven.

sentences.zh: 丁未，立州縣墾田增虧賞罰格。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: reward-and-punishment standards for reclaimed-field gains and losses in prefectures and counties were set.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, prefectural reclaimed-field reward and penalty rules were set.

sentences.zh: 是月，命復蠟祭。

translations.literal: That month: wax sacrifice was restored.
translations.idiomatic: That month, wax sacrifice was restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，金岐王亮弑其主亶自立。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: Jin Prince of Qi Liang killed his ruler Xi'an and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingsi: the Jin Prince of Qi, Liang, killed Emperor Xi'an and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔無子女戶、得解舉人、太學生之獨居者並免役。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: an edict exempted from corvée households without sons or daughters, passed metropolitan exam candidates, and solitary Imperial Academy students.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, households without children, passed metropolitan candidates, and lone academy students were freed from corvée.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命四川制置司歲募扈衛三百人赴行在。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Sichuan disposition commission was ordered yearly to recruit three hundred bodyguards for the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Sichuan disposition was told yearly to recruit three hundred guards for court.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，金遣完顏袞等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the Jin sent Wanyan Gun and others to congratulate next year's New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Jin sent Wanyan Gun and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月丁亥，秦檜入朝，殿前司軍士施全道刺之，不中。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, spring, first month, day dinghai: Qin Hui attended court; Palace Front Army soldier Shi Quan waylaid and stabbed him but missed.
translations.idiomatic: Year 20, first month, dinghai: Qin Hui came to court; soldier Shi Quan ambushed and stabbed him but missed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，磔全於市。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Quan was dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Quan was torn apart in the market.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，趣諸路轉運司及守臣畢經界事。

translations.literal: Day guimao: every circuit transport office and prefect were urged to finish land-boundary work.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, circuit transport chiefs and prefects were pressed to finish land boundaries.

sentences.zh: 丙午，兩浙轉運副使曹泳言，李孟堅誦其父光所撰私史，語涉譏謗，詔送大理寺。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Liang-Zhe transport vice commissioner Cao Yong reported that Li Mengjian recited a private history by his father Li Guang with language of slander; an edict sent the case to the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Cao Yong said Li Mengjian recited father Li Guang's private history with slander; the case went to the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申朔，立守貳、令尉營田增虧賞罰格。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen new moon: reward-and-punishment standards for camp-field gains and losses by prefectural deputies and county magistrates were set.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wushen new moon: reward and penalty rules were set for deputies' and magistrates' camp fields.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禁民春月捕鳥獸。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: civilians were forbidden to catch birds and beasts in spring.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, spring hunting of birds and beasts was banned.

sentences.zh: 蠲靜江府、昭州上供折布錢三之一。

translations.literal: One-third of Jingjiang prefecture and Zhao prefecture tribute silk-cash was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjiang and Zhao tribute silk-cash was cut by one-third.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷經界所覆實官吏。

translations.literal: Day renzi: land-boundary office review officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, land-boundary review officials were abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免海外四州及瀘、敘二州、長寧軍經界。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: land boundaries were waived for the four overseas prefectures, Lu and Xu prefectures, and Changning army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, land boundaries were dropped for four overseas prefectures, Lu, Xu, and Changning.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，以沒入官田悉歸常平司，禁募民佃種。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi: confiscated official fields all went to the Ever-Normal Office; recruiting civilians to farm them was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, renzi: seized official fields went to the Ever-Normal Office; hiring civilians to farm them was banned.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，置力田科，募江、漸、福建民耕兩淮閒田。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the Strong-Farming examination was established to recruit civilians from Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian to farm vacant fields between the two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, a Strong-Farming exam was set to recruit Jiang, Zhe, and Fujian farmers for vacant land between the Huai.

sentences.zh: 是月，信州妖賊黃曾等作亂，陷貴溪縣，江西兵馬鈐轄李橫等討平之。

translations.literal: That month: demonic bandit Huang Zeng and others rose in Xin prefecture and took Guiqi county; Jiangxi military controller Li Heng and others suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xin bandit Huang Zeng seized Guiqi; Jiangxi controller Li Heng and others put them down.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，申禁諸軍差承接文字使臣伺察朝政。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengchen: an edict again forbade armies from dispatching liaison envoys and civil officials to spy on court politics.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengchen: armies were again barred from sending liaison envoys and officials to watch court politics.

sentences.zh: 癸未，秦檜上《中興聖統》。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Qin Hui presented the Restoration Imperial Lineage.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Qin Hui submitted the Restoration Imperial Lineage.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金就遣完顏思恭等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Jin at once sent Wanyan Sigong and others to congratulate the Heavenly Succession Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Jin promptly sent Wanyan Sigong and others for the Heavenly Succession Festival.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，加秦熺少保。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: Qin Xi was promoted to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guihai: Qin Xi became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔大理寺鞫前太常主簿吳元美譏謗獄。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Court of Judicial Review to try former Directorate of Ritual registrar Wu Yuanmei for slander.
translations.idiomatic: The court told the Court of Judicial Review to try former ritual registrar Wu Yuanmei for slander.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禁民結集經社。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: civilians were forbidden to form scripture societies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, civilian scripture societies were banned.

sentences.zh: 是月，建州民張大一作亂。

translations.literal: That month: Jian prefecture commoner Zhang Dayi rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jian commoner Zhang Dayi rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，罷招刺禁軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingzi: recruitment of sharp-shooting forbidden-army troops was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingzi: sharp-shooting forbidden-army recruitment was ended.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷泉、漳、汀三州經界。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the land-boundary survey in Quan, Zhang, and Ting prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the land-boundary survey in Quan, Zhang, and Ting was ended.

sentences.zh: 八月申辰朔，量移張浚永州、孫近虔州、万俟禼沅州、李若谷饒州、李文會江州、段拂南康軍，並居住。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day shenyin new moon: Zhang Jun was transferred to Yongzhou, Sun Jin to Qianzhou, Moqi Xi to Yuanzhou, Li Ruogu to Raozhou, Li Wenhui to Jiangzhou, and Duan Fu to Nankang army—all for registered residence.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, shenyin new moon: Zhang Jun was moved to Yongzhou, Sun Jin to Qianzhou, Moqi Xi to Yuanzhou, Li Ruogu to Raozhou, Li Wenhui to Jiangzhou, and Duan Fu to Nankang—all under registered residence.

sentences.zh: 雷州守臣王ＡＺ坐交通趙鼎、李光停官。

translations.literal: Leizhou prefectural officer Wang Yue was dismissed for communicating with Zhao Ding and Li Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Leizhou prefect Wang Yue was dismissed for contact with Zhao Ding and Li Guang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，改建大理寺。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the Dali Temple was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Dali Temple was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣陳誠之使金賀正旦，王�賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Chen Chengji was sent as envoy to the Jin to congratulate the New Year; Wang Moqing was sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Chen Chengji was sent to the Jin for New Year greetings; Wang Moqing for the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，以吳元美譏毀大臣，除名、容州編管。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: because Wu Yuanmei slandered great ministers, he was struck from the rolls and placed under registered supervision at Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiashen: Wu Yuanmei, for slandering great ministers, was struck from the rolls and banished to registered supervision at Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，侍御史曹筠以附下罔上罷。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Supervising Censor Cao Jun was dismissed for currying favor below and deceiving above.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Supervising Censor Cao Jun was dismissed for fawning on subordinates and deceiving his superiors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，右迪功郎安誠坐文字謗訕，送惠州編管。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: Right Credentialled Gentleman An Cheng, on account of written slander, was sent to registered supervision at Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuchen: Right Credentialled Gentleman An Cheng was sent to Huizhou for written slander.

sentences.zh: 秦檜有疾。

translations.literal: Qin Hui fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui fell ill.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命執政赴檜第議事。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the chief ministers were ordered to Qin's residence to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the chief ministers were told to meet at Qin Hui's house.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，檜始朝，命肩輿入宮門，二孫扶掖升殿，不拜。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: Qin first attended court; he was ordered to enter the palace gate in a shoulder litter, his two grandsons supporting him up the hall, and he did not bow.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiazi: Qin first came to court in a litter, two grandsons helping him to the hall without bowing.

sentences.zh: 己巳，金遣蕭頤等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the Jin sent Xiao Yi and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Jin sent Xiao Yi and others to congratulate the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月癸未，以兩淮民復業未久，寬其租稅。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, spring, first month, day guimao: because the people of the two Huai had only lately returned to their occupations, their rents and taxes were eased.
translations.idiomatic: Year 21, spring, guimao: because Huai people had only lately returned home, their rents and taxes were eased.

sentences.zh: 庚子，蠲平江府折帛錢三年。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Pingjiang prefecture's commuted silk payments were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Pingjiang's commuted silk payments were cut for three years.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅夜，雨雹。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin night: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiayin night: hail fell.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔諸州置惠民局，官給醫書。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict ordered every prefecture to set up Benevolent Relief Bureaus and supply medical books at state expense.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, every prefecture was to open Benevolent Relief Bureaus with state-supplied medical books.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣巫伋等為金國祈請使，請歸淵聖皇帝及皇族、增加帝號等事。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Wu Ji and others were sent as Jin supplication envoys to request the return of the late emperor Huizong and the imperial clan, an enhanced imperial title, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wu Ji and others were sent to the Jin to beg the return of Huizong and the clan, a higher imperial title, and the like.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以餘堯弼兼簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Yu Yaobu was made concurrent Privy Council signatory.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Yu Yaobu became concurrent Privy Council signatory.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingchou: hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，蠲江、浙、荊湖等路中戶以下積年逋負。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: arrears in rents and levies of middle households and below on Jiang, Zhe, and Jing-Hu routes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, long-overdue rents of middle households and below on Jiang, Zhe, and Jing-Hu were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 夏閏四月己卯，禁三衙掊克諸軍。

translations.literal: Summer, intercalary fourth month, day jimao: the three palace-guard offices were forbidden to squeeze the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary fourth month, jimao: the three palace-guard offices were barred from squeezing the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜禮部進士趙逵以下四百四人及第、出身。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the Ministry of Rites advanced jinshi Zhao Kui and 404 others to presented scholar and regular graduate status.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zhao Kui and 404 other jinshi passed to presented scholar and graduate.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，罷利州路選刺義士。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinhai: selection and recruitment of righteous braves on the Lizhou route was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinhai: Lizhou's righteous-brave recruitment was ended.

sentences.zh: 戊午，金遣劉長言等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Jin sent Liu Changyan and others to congratulate the Tianshen Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Jin sent Liu Changyan and others for the Tianshen Festival.

sentences.zh: 以吳璘、楊政、田師中並為太尉。

translations.literal: Wu Lin, Yang Zheng, and Tian Shizhong were all made Grand Marshals.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin, Yang Zheng, and Tian Shizhong were all made Grand Marshals.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，括淮南佃田所隱頃畝，以理租稅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu: hidden acreage of tenant fields in Huainan was inventoried to set rents and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiaxu: hidden Huainan tenant acreage was inventoried to fix rents.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命歲給大理寺、三衙及州縣錢，和藥劑療病囚。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: every year funds were allotted to the Dali Temple, the three palace guards, and prefectures and counties to compound medicines and treat sick prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, yearly funds were set for Dali, the three guards, and local jails to compound medicine for sick prisoners.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，以集英殿修撰、知衢州曹筠為四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renyin: Hanlin Academician-in-waiting and Quzhou prefect Cao Jun was made Sichuan pacification and planning commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renyin: Hanlin attendant and Quzhou prefect Cao Jun became Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，罷柴米稅。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the rice-and-fuel tax was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the rice-and-fuel tax was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔州縣官嘗被科率害民重罪者，不得任守令親民官。

translations.literal: Day guihai: an edict said officials who had once forced levies and harmed the people in capital cases might not hold prefectural or county posts that touched the people.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, officials once guilty of forced levies in capital cases were barred from people-facing prefectural posts.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌朔，籍寺觀絕產以贍學。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuxu new moon: monasteries' escheat lands were registered to support schools.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuxu new moon: monasteries' escheat lands were registered for schools.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，均科處州丁鹽錢。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the Ding salt levy in Chuzhou was equalized.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Chuzhou's Ding salt levy was equalized.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，增築景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the Jingling Palace was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Jingling Palace was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 是月，巫伋使還，所請皆不許。

translations.literal: That month Wu Ji returned from his mission; every request was denied.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wu Ji returned; every plea was refused.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，幸張俊第。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiaxu: the emperor visited Zhang Jun's residence.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiaxu: the emperor visited Zhang Jun's house.

sentences.zh: 壬午，進俊為太師，升從子子蓋為安德軍節度使。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Jun was advanced to Grand Preceptor, and his nephew's son Zigai was made Ande army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhang Jun was made Grand Preceptor and his nephew's son Zigai Ande commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，夜有赤氣。

translations.literal: Day jiashen night: a red vapor appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen night, red vapor appeared in the sky.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，餘堯弼罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengxu: Yu Yaobu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengxu: Yu Yaobu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命提舉常平官修復陂湖。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Ever-Normal Granary commissioners were ordered to repair dikes and lakes.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Ever-Normal commissioners were told to repair dikes and lakes.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，進義副尉劉允中坐指斥謗訕棄市。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Promotion-in-Merit Deputy Commander Liu Yunzhong was executed in the market for pointing and reviling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Liu Yunzhong, Promotion-in-Merit deputy commander, was executed for seditious speech.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，雷。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renshen: thunder.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，金遣兀朮魯定方等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day guisi: the Jin sent Wulu Dingfang and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the Jin sent Wulu Dingfang and others for the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月丁未，加韋淵太保。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, spring, first month, day dingwei: Wei Yuan was advanced to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Year 22, spring, dingwei: Wei Yuan was made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，以王庶二子之奇、之荀謗毀朝政，並除名，之奇梅州、之荀容州編管。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: because Wang Shu's two sons Zhiqi and Zhiqun slandered court policy, both were struck from the rolls—Zhiqi to Meizhou and Zhiqun to Rongzhou under registered supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingyou: Wang Shu's sons Zhiqi and Zhiqun, for slandering policy, were struck from the rolls and sent to Meizhou and Rongzhou supervision.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以直龍圖閣葉三省、監都作院王遠通書趙鼎、王庶，力詆和議，言涉謗訕，三省落職、筠州居住；

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Straight Dragon Hall academician Ye Sansheng and Directorate of Works overseer Wang Yuan, in letters to Zhao Ding and Wang Shu, forcefully denounced the peace policy with language touching on slander—Sansheng lost his post and was settled at Yunzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen: Ye Sansheng and Wang Yuan, writing Zhao Ding and Wang Shu to blast the peace policy, were punished—Sansheng lost rank and was settled at Yun;

sentences.zh: 遠除名、高州編管。

translations.literal: Yuan was struck from the rolls and placed under registered supervision at Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was struck from the rolls and banished to Gaozhou supervision.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣司農丞鐘世明詣福建路籍寺觀絕產田宅入官，其後歲入錢三十四萬緡。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Agriculture Bureau vice director Zhong Shiming was sent to the Fujian circuit to register monasteries' escheat fields and houses into state ownership; thereafter the yearly intake was 340,000 strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi: Zhong Shiming was sent to Fujian to seize monasteries' escheat lands; yearly intake thereafter reached 340,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子，巫伋罷。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingzi: Wu Ji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingzi: Wu Ji was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以御史中丞章復簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Investigating Censor-in-Chief Zhang Fu was made Privy Council signatory with acting participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Fu became Privy Council signatory and acting participation in governance.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，金遣田秀穎等來賀天申節。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guichou: the Jin sent Tian Xiuying and others to congratulate the Tianshen Festival.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guichou: the Jin sent Tian Xiuying and others for the Tianshen Festival.

sentences.zh: 是月，襄陽大水，容州野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: That month Xiangyang suffered great flood; in Rongzhou wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiangyang flooded; in Rongzhou wild silkworms spun cocoons.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午朔，加封程嬰、公孫杵臼、韓厥為公，升中祀。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiawu new moon: Cheng Ying, Gongsun Chujiu, and Han Jue were advanced to duke and raised to secondary sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiawu new moon: Cheng Ying, Gongsun Chujiu, and Han Jue were made dukes and raised to secondary sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，虔州軍卒齊述殺殿前司統制吳進、江西同統領馬晟，據州叛。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Ganzhou soldier Qi Shu killed Palace Front Office controller Wu Jin and Jiangxi co-controller Ma Sheng, seized the prefecture, and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Ganzhou soldier Qi Shu killed Wu Jin and Ma Sheng and seized the prefecture in revolt.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，遣鄂州都統制田師中發兵同江西安撫使張澄、殿前司游奕軍統制李耕討述。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jimao: Ezhou overall commander Tian Shizhong was sent with Jiangxi pacification commissioner Zhang Cheng and Palace Front Roaming Strike controller Li Geng to suppress Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jimao: Tian Shizhong, Zhang Cheng, and Li Geng were sent to crush Qi Shu.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，又遣左翼軍統制陳敏相繼討之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiwei: Left Wing Army controller Chen Min was again sent in succession to pursue the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, yiwei: Left Wing controller Chen Min was sent next in the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，章復罷。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhang Fu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhang Fu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，以御史中丞宋樸簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiaxu: Investigating Censor-in-Chief Song Pu was made Privy Council signatory with acting participation in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiaxu: Censor-in-Chief Song Pu became Privy Council signatory and acting participation in governance.

sentences.zh: 就命李耕知虔州。

translations.literal: Li Geng was then appointed on the spot to govern Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Geng was then made Qianzhou prefect on the spot.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以黃岩縣令楊煒誹謗，除名、萬安軍編管；

translations.literal: Day gengchen: because Huangyan county magistrate Yang Wei had slandered, he was struck from the rolls and placed under registered supervision at Wan'an army;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen: Yang Wei of Huangyan, for slander, was struck from the rolls and banished to Wan'an supervision;

sentences.zh: 知台州蕭振落職、池州居住。

translations.literal: Taizhou prefect Xiao Zhen lost his post and was settled at Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou prefect Xiao Zhen was demoted and settled at Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Circular Mound; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wushen: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed together at the Circular Mound and the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，立薦舉受財刑名。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: statutes on receiving bribes in recommendation were enacted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, statutes on bribery in recommendation were enacted.

sentences.zh: 李耕入虔州，盡誅叛兵，虔州平。

translations.literal: Li Geng entered Qianzhou, executed all the rebel soldiers, and Qianzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Li Geng entered Qianzhou, killed every rebel soldier, and the prefecture was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉朔，減夔州路及蒲江、淯井兩監鹽錢歲八萬二千緡有奇。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou new moon: the yearly salt levy of Kuizhou circuit and the Pu River and Yu River salt offices was reduced by 82,000-odd strings.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinyou new moon: Kuizhou and the Pu and Yu salt offices lost 82,000-odd strings in yearly salt levies.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金遣張利用等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the Jin sent Zhang Liyong and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Jin sent Zhang Liyong and others for the coming New Year.
